description: Jan Evertsenstraat 45-53 odd, 52-64 even and 68-90 even (J.F. Staal on 68-92, 1925-27): plain brown brick, three wide windows per house with small-pane top lights (ladder lights on 43-53), a glass-block band over the continuous rigid canopy, a tall plain parapet (about 3.1 m) with a thin coping

parapet.note: 3.1 m of plain brick over the storeys (14.1-17.2 m on 49)

corner-tower.note: 66 (Marco Polostraat) and 52-56: raised flat-topped corner masses

rhythm.groundFloor: shop under the continuous rigid canopy, a glass-block band over it
rhythm.signage: letters on the glass-block band (not drawn)
rhythm.roofline: tall plain parapet with a thin coping
schemaLimits: 43-53's windows are small-paned all over (ladder-like crosses at thirds); drawn as a gridded top light over two casements
signs on the glass-block band are not drawn
